actions.name: delete_action_item
actions.description: Delete action item. Permanently deletes an action item. Returns the deleted action item.

actionItemId.description: The unique identifier of the action item.

actions.name: update_action_item
actions.description: Update action item. Updates the title, description, status, or assignee of an action item. Returns the updated action item.

actionItemId.description: The unique identifier of the action item.

title.description: The title of the action item.

description.description: The detailed description of the action item.

assigneeProfileId.description: The ID of the profile to assign the action item to, or null to remove the assignee.

status.description: The completion status of the action item.

actions.name: list_action_items
actions.description: List action items. Returns a page of action items across the authenticated user's meetings, filtered by assignee, status, tags, attendees, and attendee domains.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

assigneeType.description: The assignee type to filter by. Defaults to Me, or to MyWorkspace when `assigneeTeamId` is set. Ignored when `assigneeProfileId` is set.

assigneeProfileId.description: Profile ID of the assignee to filter by. Takes precedence over `assigneeType`.

assigneeTeamId.description: Team ID to narrow MyWorkspace to one team. Implies MyWorkspace when `assigneeType` is not set, and is ignored for other types.

status.description: Completion status to filter by. Defaults to incomplete action items.

attendeeDomains.description: Attendee email domains to filter by. Returns action items from meetings with an attendee from any of the domains.

attendeeProfileIds.description: Profile IDs of meeting attendees to filter by.

actions.name: create_action_item
actions.description: Create action item. Creates an action item owned by the authenticated user.

title.description: The title of the action item.

description.description: The detailed description of the action item.

actions.name: list_calendar_events
actions.description: List calendar events. Returns upcoming calendar events from the authenticated user's connected calendars, with pagination and a configurable time window.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

includeOfflineSingleAttendee.description: Set to true to include calendar meetings that have no meeting link and only one attendee.

startTimeLookbackHours.description: How many hours in the past to include calendar meetings from, based on their start time.

startTimeLookaheadHours.description: How many hours in the future to include calendar meetings from, based on their start time.

sortDirection.description: The direction calendar meetings are sorted in by start time. Defaults to ascending.

actions.name: update_meeting_for_calendar_event
actions.description: Update meeting for calendar event. Sets your private notes or tags on the Circleback meeting for a calendar event, creating the meeting if needed. Each field you provide replaces its current value, and fields you leave out stay the same. Returns the meeting.

calendarMeetingId.description: The ID of the calendar meeting.

privateNotes.description: Your private notes for the meeting in Markdown. Replaces your current private notes, so include any existing content you want to keep.

tagIds.description: The IDs of the tags to set on the meeting. Replaces the meeting's current tags, so include the IDs of any tags you want to keep. Pass an empty array to remove all tags.

actions.name: list_companies
actions.description: List companies. Returns the companies whose people attend the authenticated user's meetings, with optional tag filters.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

tagIds.description: Filter companies to those with meetings that have these tag IDs.

actions.name: get_company
actions.description: Get company. Returns a company by its domain, including its people and external links.

domain.description: The domain of the company to fetch.

actions.name: list_folders
actions.description: List folders. Returns the folders the authenticated user can see, including closed folders they haven't joined and, for workspace admins, their workspace's hidden folders.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.description: Create folder. Creates a shared folder in a workspace, with optional rules that file new meetings into it.

visibility.description: Hidden folders are listed only to members and admins.

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace to create the folder in.

anyOf.description: A folder icon name or a single emoji.

ruleGroups.description: The rules that file new meetings into the folder. A meeting matches when any group matches, and a group matches when all its conditions do.

operator.description: Each type allows only some operators.

actions.name: delete_folder
actions.description: Delete folder. Deletes a shared folder. Its meetings stay with their owners. Meetings that were only in this folder go back to their creators' Private.

folderId.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

actions.name: get_folder
actions.description: Get folder. Returns folders with their members, teams, and rules. Pending invitations are only listed to people who manage the folder. People who open a folder by its link get no members, teams, or rules.

folderId.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

actions.name: update_folder
actions.description: Update folder. Updates a folder's name, description, icon, icon color, visibility, or rules. Fields you leave out stay the same, and ruleGroups replaces all of the folder's rules. Returns the folder.

folderId.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

description.description: Plain text. Links are written in Markdown, as `[text](url)`.

visibility.description: Hidden folders are listed only to members and admins.

anyOf.description: A folder icon name or a single emoji.

ruleGroups.description: The rules that file new meetings into the folder. A meeting matches when any group matches, and a group matches when all its conditions do.

operator.description: Each type allows only some operators.

actions.name: share_folder
actions.description: Share folder. Shares a folder with people, teams, workspaces, or anyone with its link, changes their access, or removes them. People outside the folder's workspace, even without an account, can be added by email. On the workspace folder, only a workspace's access can change. Returns the updated folder.

folderId.description: The unique identifier of the folder.

body.description: The people, teams, workspaces, or link to share with, up to 50. Targets that fail are listed in errors; the rest still apply.

access.description: The access level to grant to the folder's meetings, or `NoAccess` to keep them in the folder without access. Set to null to remove them. New grants get Editor.

email.description: The email address to share the folder with.

isContributor.description: Whether the folder's rules file their matching meetings. People in the folder's workspace can add their meetings by hand either way; people outside it need this. New grants don't contribute.

isOwner.description: Whether they own the folder. Only people in its workspace can.

profileId.description: The ID of the person to share the folder with.

access.description: The access level to grant to the folder's meetings, or `NoAccess` to keep them in the folder without access. Set to null to remove them. New grants get Editor.

isContributor.description: Whether the folder's rules file their matching meetings. People in the folder's workspace can add their meetings by hand either way; people outside it need this. New grants don't contribute.

isOwner.description: Whether they own the folder. Only people in its workspace can.

access.description: The access level to grant to the folder's meetings, or `NoAccess` to keep them in the folder without access. Set to null to remove them. New grants get Editor.

isContributor.description: Whether the folder's rules file their matching meetings. People in the folder's workspace can add their meetings by hand either way; people outside it need this. New grants don't contribute.

teamId.description: The unique identifier of the team to share the folder with.

access.description: The access level to grant to the folder's meetings, or `NoAccess` to keep them in the folder without access. Set to null to remove them. New grants get Editor.

isContributor.description: Whether the folder's rules file their matching meetings. People in the folder's workspace can add their meetings by hand either way; people outside it need this. New grants don't contribute.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace to share the folder with.

linkAccess.description: The access level for anyone with the folder link. Set to null for members only.

actions.name: delete_meeting
actions.description: Delete meeting. Deletes a meeting. Only the owner of the meeting can delete it. Returns the deleted meeting.

meetingId.description: The unique identifier of the meeting.

actions.name: get_meeting
actions.description: Get meeting. Returns a meeting by its ID, including the notes, attendees, and recording details the caller has permission to view.

meetingId.description: The unique identifier of the meeting.

actions.name: update_meeting
actions.description: Update meeting. Updates a meeting's name, notes, private notes, tags, or folders. Each field you provide replaces its current value, and fields you leave out stay the same. To add to notes, tags, or folders, get the meeting first and include what's already there. Returns the meeting.

meetingId.description: The unique identifier of the meeting.

name.description: The meeting's name. Replaces the current name.

notes.description: The meeting's notes in Markdown. Replaces the current notes, so include any existing content you want to keep.

privateNotes.description: Your private notes for the meeting in Markdown. Replaces your current private notes, so include any existing content you want to keep.

folderIds.description: The IDs of the folders to put the meeting in. Replaces the meeting's current folders, so start from its folderIds in ReadMeetings and include any you want to keep. Use ListFolders to find folder IDs. Folders that can't be added are listed in folderErrors; the rest still apply and nothing is removed.

tagIds.description: The IDs of the tags to set on the meeting. Replaces the meeting's current tags, so include the IDs of any tags you want to keep. Pass an empty array to remove all tags.

actions.name: share_meeting
actions.description: Share meeting. Shares a meeting with people, teams, workspaces, or the link, or removes their access. Returns the updated meeting.

meetingId.description: The unique identifier of the meeting.

body.description: The people, teams, workspaces, or link to share with, up to 50. Targets that fail are listed in errors; the rest still apply.

access.description: The access level to grant. Set to null to remove access.

email.description: The email address to share the meeting with.

sendEmail.description: Set to true to email the people the meeting is shared with.

profileId.description: The ID of the person to share the meeting with.

access.description: The access level to grant. Set to null to remove access.

sendEmail.description: Set to true to email the people the meeting is shared with.

access.description: The access level to grant. Set to null to remove access.

sendEmail.description: Set to true to email the people the meeting is shared with.

teamId.description: The unique identifier of the team to share the meeting with.

access.description: The access level to grant. Set to null to remove access.

sendEmail.description: Set to true to email the people the meeting is shared with.

workspaceId.description: The unique identifier of the workspace to share the meeting with.

linkAccess.description: The access level for anyone with the meeting link. Set to null to turn off the link.

actions.name: get_meeting_transcript
actions.description: Get meeting transcript. Returns the full transcript for a meeting.

meetingId.description: The unique identifier of the meeting.

actions.name: list_meetings
actions.description: List meetings. Returns a page of meetings for the authenticated user, optionally filtered by attendees, attendee domains, tags, ownership, status, creation time, and folder.

ownership.description: Mine (the default) for meetings the user owns, Shared for meetings shared with the user, or All for both.

createdAtGte.description: Earliest meeting creation time to include, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

createdAtLte.description: Latest meeting creation time to include, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

attendeeProfileIds.description: Profile IDs of attendees to filter by.

attendeeDomains.description: Attendee email domains to filter by. Returns meetings with an attendee from any of the domains.

actions.name: import_meeting
actions.description: Import meeting. Imports an existing meeting with notes, a transcript, and attendees. Imported meetings work like any other meeting in Circleback.

createdAt.description: Meeting creation date, formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Defaults to now.

tags.description: Tags to add to the meeting.

name.description: The display name of the tag.

isCalendarEventOrganizer.description: Whether the attendee organized the calendar event.

isCalendarInvitee.description: Whether the attendee was invited on the calendar event.

transcript.description: The segments of the transcript. Provide text and timestamp, or a words array with optional word-level timestamps.

language.description: The language code of the speech in the segment, if the language was detected.

speaker.description: The name of the speaker in the segment.

timestamp.description: Timestamp in seconds that marks the beginning of the segment.

words.description: The words spoken in the segment. Use this instead of text when word-level timestamps are available.

endTimestamp.description: The time the word ends at, in seconds from the beginning of the meeting.

startTimestamp.description: The time the word starts at, in seconds from the beginning of the meeting.

sharedWith.description: People to share the meeting with.

email.description: The email address to share the meeting with.

actions.name: get_current_account
actions.description: Get the current account.

actions.name: list_people
actions.description: List people. Returns the people who attend the authenticated user's meetings, ordered by most recent meeting, with optional company and tag filters.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

domains.description: Filter people to those associated with any of these company domains.

limit.description: The maximum number of people to return.

tagIds.description: Filter people to attendees of meetings with these tag IDs.

actions.name: get_person
actions.description: Get person. Returns a person by their profile ID, including their profile details and external links.

profileId.description: The unique identifier of the person's profile.

actions.name: search_meetings
actions.description: Search meetings. Searches the authenticated user's meetings by name, content, and transcripts, with optional filters for specific meetings, tags, and people.

searchTerm.description: The text to search for across meeting names and content.

meetingIds.description: Restrict the search to the meetings with these IDs.

tagIds.description: Restrict the search to meetings with these tag IDs.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omit for the first page (RFC 8288).

attendeeProfileIds.description: Restrict the search to meetings attended by the people with these profile IDs.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: List tags. Returns every tag available to the authenticated user.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.description: Create tag. Creates a new tag. If a tag with the same name already exists, a conflict error is returned.

name.description: The display name of the tag.

actions.name: delete_tag
actions.description: Delete tag. Permanently deletes a tag and removes it from every meeting it was applied to.

actions.name: update_tag
actions.description: Update tag. Updates a tag's name or description.

name.description: The display name of the tag.
